style: Bright nature picture-book look for a second-grade science tool: each plant and animal easy to recognize from across a classroom, accurate shapes and colors.

assets.name: bg-rainforest
assets.prompt: Empty background: inside a lush tropical rainforest at a child's eye level. Tall tree trunks with buttress roots at the sides, hanging vines, layers of green leaves high up, misty light beams, a mossy log on the forest floor and soft earth. Leave plenty of open space on the trunks, branches and ground. No animals, no flowers, no people.

assets.name: bg-desert
assets.prompt: Empty background: a wide sunny desert at a child's eye level. Sandy ground with a few rocks and pebbles, a low red rock mesa far away, a clear blue sky. Wide open sandy space. No plants, no cactus, no animals, no people.

assets.name: bg-pond
assets.prompt: Empty background: a calm freshwater pond at a child's eye level, seen from the grassy bank. The bottom half is clear pond water with a little underwater view of sand and stones near the bottom edge, the top part shows the far grassy bank, a few distant trees and blue sky. No plants in the water, no animals, no people.

assets.name: bg-backyard
assets.prompt: Empty background: a sunny family backyard at a child's eye level. Green lawn, a brown garden bed of soil along the bottom, a wooden fence behind, a blue sky with soft clouds. Wide open space. No trees, no flowers, no animals, no people, no toys.
